payload.title: Boundary: Papyrus newsroom stays editorial (no promote stage)
payload.description:
Parked boundary — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Boundary

Papyrus / ANTH newsroom stays **editorial** and **stops at published**. Do not add a promote stage on Papyrus/ANTH.

A published piece may become an Asset or seed a Campaign. Publicist cuts Slots and SharePayloads in Babulus. Newsroom does not grow a “promote” column.

No journalist media lists, pitches, or clip books in this epic.
